implementation_summary: Added specs/status-enum-registry.json as a local/static 3-axis status vocabulary seed with decision_status, maturity_status, and constraint_status fields.
Added five GOOD/BAD fixtures covering valid aligned status fields, invalid/retired REAL live-field use, spec-without-code, code-without-spec, and spec/manifest status drift.
Added scripts/ci/assert-status-enum-drift.py and scripts/tests/status_enum_drift_check.test.sh with fail-closed mutation probes while preserving all live authority claims as false.
Registered //:status-enum-drift-check in Buck2 plus AC-0.14 red/green fixture contract, AC-0.16 automation matrix/coverage registry, Buck2 authority policy, and root-hub pointers.
Fixed the AC-0.14 Buck2 red/green genrule sandbox by including checked-in scripts/tests/*.py marker/test files, including scripts/tests/phase0_ci_enforcement_baseline_catalog_check.py.
Changed the status-enum automated chain from buck2 test over a genrule to buck2 build //:status-enum-drift-check --show-output so evidence does not imply native Buck2 tests ran.

Kept modern Rust standards aligned with the recorded Buck2-native LLVM source-coverage and dual Cargo/Buck2 local mutation-testing direction; this AC-0.2 slice does not implement a new Rust toolchain lane.
residual_risks: This is seed/fixture coverage only; full manifest/PRD conformance remains explicitly unproven.
The status-drift live gate remains false until trusted cloud-ci/oya-ci executes and posts the required oya-ci-required context.
Future slices must expand the registry beyond the real-estate seed surface before broad service/readiness claims are permitted.

review_facets.F8_architecture: PASS: separates decision, maturity, and constraint semantics so readiness claims cannot collapse into a single ambiguous status token.
review_facets.F9_compliance: PASS: claim boundary preserves live required-context, full manifest/PRD conformance, P0.0 green, Phase-0 completion, production-ready, and hyperscaler-grade non-claims.
